description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1431-1490 — NormalizedIter normalizes whitespace by:
  1. Stripping leading/trailing b' ' (0x20)  
  2. Collapsing internal runs of b' ' (0x20) to a single space

RFC 4518 §2.4 (Insignificant Space Handling) specifies insignificant characters per §6.1.3 of the Unicode spec. While RFC 4518 primarily focuses on the SPACE character (U+0020 = 0x20 in UTF-8), there are edge cases.

More specifically, RFC 4518 §2.1 step 2 (Map) converts certain characters to empty strings. The current implementation only handles the U+0020 SPACE. Tabs (0x09), carriage returns (0x0D), and other whitespace variants in non-ASCII strings may pass through unchanged, potentially causing false non-matches.

However, RFC 5280 §4.1.2.4 restricts DN strings to PrintableString and UTF8String. In practice, tab characters in PrintableString DNs are invalid (PrintableString doesn't include tab). For UTF8String, non-space whitespace is unlikely but possible.

This is a v0.2 limitation already documented in the code ('Full Unicode NFKC normalization is deferred to v0.2'). The current scope handles the most common cases correctly.

P3 — edge case whitespace types not handled, documented as known limitation.
title: pkix-path NormalizedIter: handles only space (0x20) not all RFC 4518 insignificant whitespace
